title: Three Claude Code Skills That Will Fix Your AI Web Design Immediately
description: Three Claude Code Skills That Will Fix Your AI Web Design Immediately
transcript: If you're using Claude code for web design, here are three skills you should be using. First is the front-end design skill by Anthropic. This is the fastest way to go from those rough-looking AI slop designs to high-quality polished designs. Second is the UI/UX Pro Max skill. Think of this as the front-end skill, but turned all the way up. It comes with a built-in reasoning layer that adapts depending on what you're building. So, you're not just going to get a generic design, you're going to get a context-aware design. And third is Playwright CLI. It's not technically a design tool, but it's perfect for testing everything that you build. Say you set up a workflow, instead of clicking through it yourself, have Claude spin up some browser instances and work through it for you. It's a massive time-saver and catches way more edge cases than you think.
